headline: Google AI opt-out removes Top Stories eligibility; publishers face traffic trade-off

SERP & Algorithm Signals.what_happened: Data: higher AI-detector scores correlate with lower rankings and fewer indexed pages, yet heavily flagged pages still appear in top 10
SERP & Algorithm Signals.why_it_matters: AI内容检测与排名存在相关性但非因果：纯AI内容可能受质量评估影响，但AI检测分数本身不是排名因素，内容质量评估仍是核心。
SERP & Algorithm Signals.evidence: Correlation data: higher AI scores tied to lower positions and fewer indexed pages; counterexamples in top 10
SERP & Algorithm Signals.what_to_do: 聚焦E-E-A-T和内容质量，而非AI检测分数；监控AI辅助内容的实际表现

Technical SEO Experiments.what_happened: Google's Gary Illyes uncertain whether repeatedly pushing unavailable_after dates forward causes indexing problems
Technical SEO Experiments.why_it_it_matters: 对于使用unavailable_after meta标签管理时效性内容的publisher和ecommerce站点，频繁更新日期可能导致不可预见的索引行为，需重新评估内容过期策略。
Technical SEO Experiments.evidence: Gary Illyes primary-source statement: 'would need to check' if forward-shifting dates cause problems
Technical SEO Experiments.what_to_do: 审计现有unavailable_after实现，避免频繁修改日期；监控受影响页面索引状态

Technical SEO Experiments.what_happened: Google confirms random CMS-injected URLs in HTML have minimal SEO impact if not linked or indexed
Technical SEO Experiments.why_it_matters: 减少技术SEO中的低价值修复优先级：CMS自动注入的未链接URL不会直接损害排名，可将资源转向更高影响的索引和抓取优化。
Technical SEO Experiments.evidence: John Mueller primary-source statement on CMS-injected URL impact
Technical SEO Experiments.what_to_do: 确认注入URL未被链接/索引即可，无需紧急修复；优先处理实际索引问题

AI Search / GEO.what_happened: Google places Top Stories carousels inside AI Overviews; opting out of AI training in Search Console may remove Top Stories placement
AI Search / GEO.why_it_matters: 出版商面临关键权衡：选择退出AI训练可保护内容不被用于AI Overviews，但会失去Top Stories这一重要流量入口，直接影响新闻类publisher的有机流量。
AI Search / GEO.evidence: Search Engine Journal报道，Google确认AI opt-out设置与Top Stories资格挂钩
AI Search / GEO.what_to_do: 评估AI opt-out对Top Stories流量的影响，测试保留与退出的流量差异

AI Search / GEO.what_happened: Study: AI recognizes 96% of brands but mentions almost none in responses, creating visibility gap
AI Search / GEO.why_it_matters: 品牌GEO优化存在严重盲区：AI系统能识别品牌但极少主动提及，意味着传统品牌搜索优化无法转化为AI引用(GEO/AEO)收益，需建立新的品牌mention策略。
AI Search / GEO.evidence: Victorious study with quantified data: 96% recognition vs. near-zero mention rate
AI Search / GEO.what_to_do: 测试结构化品牌mention在AI响应中的出现率；优化知识图谱实体关联

Tools, Papers & Open Source.what_happened: Google lost DMCA scraping case against SerpApi; SearchGuard ruling prioritizes ad revenue over copyright protection
Tools, Papers & Open Source.why_it_matters: 反爬虫法律框架弱化：网站更难通过DMCA阻止AI爬虫抓取，需重新评估robots.txt、terms of service和技术反制措施的组合策略。
Tools, Papers & Open Source.evidence: Court ruling: SearchGuard protects ad revenue not copyright; weakens anti-bot defense precedent
Tools, Papers & Open Source.what_to_do: 审查robots.txt和TOS条款；考虑速率限制、认证墙等技术手段替代法律手段

Today's Action Items.what_to_do: P0: 检查Search Console中的AI opt-out设置，评估Top Stories资格影响
P1: 审计unavailable_after标签实现，避免频繁修改日期
P1: 更新反爬虫策略，补充robots.txt和技术防护替代法律手段
P2: 测试品牌mention在AI响应中的出现率，优化知识图谱实体
